hook.name: FoxyFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-adaptive ETH fee hook for FoxyLaunch pools that charges fees in native ETH on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), scaling between configurable base and max fee rates (1%–7%) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Only the bound factory may open pools on this hook; only exact-input swaps are permitted.
